proof_body:
by
  intro a x y ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    linarith [mul_nonneg ha.le (sq_nonneg (x - t))]
  · intro h
    have hE : 0 ≤ (a * x ^ 2 - y) / a := div_nonneg (by linarith) ha.le
    refine ⟨x + Real.sqrt ((a * x ^ 2 - y) / a), ?_⟩
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hE
    have ha' : a * ((a * x ^ 2 - y) / a) = a * x ^ 2 - y := by field_simp
    have : 2 * a * (x + Real.sqrt ((a * x ^ 2 - y) / a)) * x - a * (x + Real.sqrt ((a * x ^ 2 - y) / a)) ^ 2 = a * x ^ 2 - a * Real.sqrt ((a * x ^ 2 - y) / a) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this, hs, ha']; ring
